messages:
maria: nightly-eval-bot flagged a big drop in multi-turn-coherence for rwd-v2-int8 on the 'customer-support' promptset. avg rouge dropped ~18% vs baseline. :eyes:
nightly-eval-bot: failing_examples: 42, model: rwd-v2-int8, run_id: 2026-03-19-23, diff_summary: 'shorter responses, hallucinations in follow-ups'
aj: weird, we didn't change prompts. any infra changes last night?
ryan: there was a runtime patch to pack KV slots for int8 quantized runs (PR #4241). changed slot_stride from 64->56 to pack more per tensor.
sophia: that packing change was supposed to be safe; we added a rehash salt to avoid tenant collisions though. can someone grep for prefix-cache collisions in logs?
maria: reproducer: run nightly eval with `--batch-size 4 --enable-prefix-cache` vs `--batch-size 1` and you'll see regression only at batch>1. curl replay: `curl -X POST https://local-replay/api/replay -d '{"run_id":"2026-03-19-23","batch":4}'`
kevin: I pulled KV traces. I see two distinct tenants mapping to same cache slot range during high concurrency. looks like the slot index calculation uses `((prefix_hash >> 16) % slots_per_shard)` and slots_per_shard changed because of packing.
aj: so slot numbering shifted but salt was constant -> different prefixes now alias. that could explain nondeterministic collisions and truncated prefixes leading to short/garbled continuation.
ryan: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-19T23:04:12Z] prefix_key=tenant=acme:conv=1234; slot=872; cache_hit=true; kv_slot_owner=tenant=otherco
[2026-03-19T23:04:12Z] generated: "Thanks for reaching out." -> next token mismatch (expected "Please provide")
```
sophia: interestingly failures cluster on prompts where prefix len ~120 tokens and many concurrent short requests. sounds like partial KV reuse where tail tokens from another tenant are pulled into cache.
maria: quick mitigation idea: add per-tenant slot-salt in runtime config to make keyspace tenant-unique immediately, or temporarily disable prefix cache for int8 variants until we validate packing math.
kevin: hotfix candidate: revert slot_stride change OR recompute salt using `(model_id, tenant_id, slot_stride)` so salt changes when stride changes. small patch, can cut a canary for private/dedicated first.
aj: ops: can we rollout a canary to dedicated cluster A with `--prefix-cache-tenant-salt=enabled`? if that fixes nightly diffs we ship to hosted.
ryan: I'll attach a small reproducer script and kv-dump snippet to the ticket. also add an eval that repeats with permutations of batch sizes and slot_stride to catch regressions.
sophia: also add unit test asserting that cache_key(prefix, tenant) != cache_key(prefix, other_tenant) for all supported strides.
maria: plan: 1) small rehash-salt patch -> canary (2h), 2) run nightly eval replay with batch variants (4h), 3) revert or roll forward based on pass. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml.
kevin: ack. I'll open incident ticket and schedule the canary. :thumbsup:
